<MethodEndpoint
  method={"put"}
  path={"/license"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Self-hosted installations, staff users only. Verifies a license against this installation (signature, installation id, validity dates) and, when it is valid, makes it the license in force; returns the new status. Works in read-only mode too. 400 with `code: license_invalid` and the verification error when it is not valid.
